title: A crash mid-loop resumes from the checkpoint without rolling again
description: Two dice rolls are recorded, then the model connection drops. The turn fails retryable; the retry replays the recorded receipts (no new dice), continues the conversation and commits. On dm-loop-v1 only.

steps.say: I take a run-up and leap the chasm.

expect.label: the turn was retried after the crash
both rolls were recorded once, no re-roll
the resumed turn applied the landing damage

leap.note: Round 1 rolls twice; round 2 is a dropped connection; round 3 (after retry) applies damage and finishes.

arguments.reason: fall damage if it goes wrong

rounds.text: …and land hard on the far side, the breath knocked out of you.
